name: Revolving Arch
hint: Standing on a plate only helps if you can stay there.
catch: the arches are a revolving door. The only way onto the east plates' lane is out through one arch and back through the other, and crates can't ride arches — so standing on a plate is useless: both east plates must hold crates, each pushed from the one side that doesn't drive it into the spring, before you take the door home.
